description: This file defines an immutable Java class TraceInformation that encapsulates tracing data such as a trace URI and associated tags. It includes a nested Builder class for constructing instances with a fluent API.

classes.name: TraceInformation
classes.description: An immutable class representing tracing information including a URI and tags. It provides getters, and overrides equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: TraceInformation.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing TraceInformation instances. It collects a trace URI and tags, and provides methods to set tags and build the final object.

methods.name: getTraceUri
methods.description: Returns the trace URI associated with this tracing information.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of tags associated with this trace.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object based on traceUri and tags.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on traceUri and tags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TraceInformation object.

methods.name: forTraceUri
methods.description: Static factory method in Builder to start building an instance with a specific trace URI.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the tags map in the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable TraceInformation instance from the builder's data.
